audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t says 'Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.' Nothing mentions that Ashen Pursuit is an auto-attack reset, or that Purgatory grounds.
audit.why: Soul Ignition heals back a portion of the damage taken during its duration — Grievous Wounds reduces healing whatever its source, so anti-heal is not optional, it is the item that breaks his extended-trade math. Ashen Pursuit resets his attack, so the wind-up is the tell rather than a cast animation. And Purgatory's grounding does not touch Decisive Strike: Garen's Q is a move-speed burst, not a dash, so he can still walk out of the zone — worth saying because a player who believes he is stuck will stand and die at the floor.
The two suspectNames hits ('Decisive Strike's', 'Demacian Justice's') are false positives — they are possessives of Garen's real ability names, matched at edit distance 2 because of the apostrophe-s.

edits.after: Purgatory grounds and executes, but it only ends fights that are already at his floor — break off early, and Grievous Wounds cuts the Soul Ignition refund he counts on to survive the second half of a trade.
